answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded work registry: each agent whose actions count must post a stake scaling with its reputation weight, slashed if its operator runs duplicates. A thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes from one wallet, draining capital per seat. Colluders cannot wander past this cap on per-source weight, and each seat needs independent proof-of-work, while overlapping attestations form a prism exposing one-funded clusters. Honest agents gather in a grove of shared stake. Stake, compute, and forfeited bonds cost more than the influence bought.
